owns: the sample mailbox's provider state (<data home>/mailbox/sample.json)
data.export: the sample mailbox's state is a JSON file; drafts, receipts and notes belong to the core and the platform

exemptions.reason: only the sample mailbox is built; a real mailbox needs an OAuth client and an account the owner creates (README, The real adapters)
the MailConnector port has one adapter; its characterisation tests stand in until a second adapter shares them

removal.rule: allowed once the triage capability is revoked and no mailbox change it carried is UNKNOWN; drafts and receipts stay with the core

swap: the vendor's official remote MCP server where it is generally available (Gmail: Google Workspace MCP; Outlook: Work IQ MCP), else a direct API adapter (Gmail API, Microsoft Graph); chosen by the entitlement check
